question: Indicate the attribute value of superhero Abomination.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "hero_attribute_values" AS SELECT t1.id AS hero_id, t1.superhero_name, t2.attribute_id, t4.attribute_name, t2.attribute_value FROM table_1 AS t1 JOIN table_2 AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.hero_id JOIN table_4 AS t4 ON t2.attribute_id = t4.id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
SELECT
  hav.superhero_name,
  hav.attribute_name,
  hav.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute_values AS hav
WHERE lower(hav.superhero_name) = 'abomination'
ORDER BY hav.attribute_name;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
SELECT CAST(REPLACE(hav.attribute_value, '"', '') AS INTEGER) AS attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute_values AS hav
WHERE lower(hav.superhero_name) = 'abomination'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN lower(hav.attribute_name) = 'power' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, hav.attribute_name
LIMIT 1;
